messages:
Alice Park: Good Monday — quick exec pulse and asks for the week. Focus areas: 1) Stability: get us to 99.95% global inference SLO, 2) Cost: target -12% cost/unit vs baseline this quarter, 3) Compliance: finish EU Private region preview. Please read and ack.

Daniel Ortega: Timeline update — EU Private preview canary goes live Thu, GA target in ~2w if metrics hold. Canary will be ~3% of EU traffic. Details & checklist: https://internal.redwood/eu-private-launch (internal).

Maya Singh: Runtime patch rolling tonight to reduce tail latency. Kernel v1.13 includes attention kernel improvements and better KV cache eviction. Canary config: --canary=3% --batch=auto. Rolling window 30m.

Maya Singh: Command we used for canary deploy:
```
rdwctl deploy --kernel v1.13 --cluster canary --percent 3
```

Raj Patel: Request from infra: please avoid non-critical infra churn 22:00-02:00 UTC during the canary window. We'll post a calendar blackout and list owners.

Lia Chen: Product gating note — we'll route EU traffic through feature-flag `eu_private_beta`. PMs, please add targeted eval prompts (privacy + perf) into the quality suite (PR #4532).

Tom Baker: Incident follow-up from last week: KV-cache misconfig caused ~18% tail latency spike during peak. Postmortem published in #postmortems: https://internal.redwood/pm/4567. Action items: add circuit breaker on cache misses, increase KV trace retention to 72h, add synthetic load tests for prefix caching.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed runtime/kernel v1.13 to canary cluster (canary=3%). Logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/deploy/1999991200

Alice Park: Leads — please confirm blackout windows, tag owners on the postmortem, and add risk mitigations in #oncall by EOD Wed. Also call out any blockers to me directly. :pray:

Daniel Ortega: :thumbsup: Noted. I'll update the rollout doc with gating thresholds: p99 < 250ms, error-rate < 0.2%, no data-plane errors.

Maya Singh: I'll watch kernels overnight and post alerts to #eng-runtime if anything moves. /remind me in 6h to check canary stats.

Raj Patel: Acknowledged — infra will coordinate the freeze calendar event and ops standby.

Lia Chen: Adding QA tasks now and will spin up test traffic for the canary. Ping me for test vectors.

Tom Baker: :rocket: Ops on standby, runbooks updated in the incident doc.

Alice Park: Thanks all — small ask cadence this week. If you see regressions, escalate immediately to the exec on-call and drop a note here. We'll do a short debrief Fri 09:00 PT.
